_comment: Live probe of session-token behavior across a region add -> remove -> re-add cycle on tomasvaron-h2sweep (Session consistency). Answers the one invariant the in-memory emulator asserted without evidence: whether a re-added region reuses its original region id. Captured with fixtures/topology/../session_probe.py (see session-state files).
conclusions: CONFIRMED: a re-added region REUSES its original region id (2 both times). The emulator's 'region ids are allocated once and never reused; a re-added region keeps its original id' invariant matches the service.
Single-region accounts emit V1 tokens with NO region component at all. The region component only appears once a second region exists.
The region id is NOT positional: with Central US (failoverPriority 0) plus East US 2 (priority 1), the added region got id 2, and the hub is not listed in the vector clock at all.
EVERY region membership change bumps the token version: -1 -> 0 on add, 2 -> 3 on remove, 3 -> 4 on re-add.

A token carrying a REMOVED region's id is ACCEPTED (HTTP 200), not rejected. The version bump is the mechanism: a lower-version token is superseded rather than compared against a topology that no longer exists.
x-ms-number-of-read-regions is (readLocations - 1): 0 with one region, 1 with two.
x-ms-last-state-change-utc is per-region, not account-global (Central US and East US 2 reported different values on the same account), and is a real timestamp rather than a sentinel.
Concurrent topology operations are rejected with HTTP 412 PreconditionFailed: 'There is already an operation in progress which requires exclusive lock on this service'.
emulator_gap_found_and_fixed: The emulator only bumped vector_clock_version on partition merge, never on a region membership change. Without that bump a stale region entry in a client token would never be superseded. EmulatorStore::advance_vector_clock_versions now runs on add_region and remove_region.

observations.note: Baseline, one region (Central US). V1 token, no region component.
First token after East US 2 became visible. Version bumped -1 -> 0; region id 2 appears with localLSN -1 (not yet caught up).
Settled two-region state. read_regions is now 1.
Region removed. Version bumped 2 -> 3 and the region entry was dropped, back to V1 shape.
STALE TOKEN TEST: sent '0:2#16#2=-1', which names the removed region id 2. Accepted with HTTP 200, no substatus; the service replied with a current token.
DECISIVE: East US 2 re-added and got region id 2 again -- the SAME id it had before removal. Version bumped 3 -> 4.
